name: Glycereth-7-triacetate
description: Glycereth-7-triacetate (CAS 57569-76-3 ), commercially available as Pelemol G 7A, is an ethoxylated glycerin triacetate used across personal care and industrial formulations. It functions as an emollient, humectant, and plasticizer. This versatile chemical provides moisture retention and film flexibility depending on the specific application. In skin and hair care formulations, it acts as a conditioning emollient that improves spreadability and skin feel. The product ensures a smooth application without leaving a heavy or greasy residue. Formulators incorporate it into creams, lotions, and serums where both moisturizing performance and emulsification support are required. In coatings and adhesive systems, it serves as a plasticizer that enhances film flexibility and substrate adhesion. Sealant and elastomer manufacturers use it to modify mechanical properties and improve processing behavior. It is particularly effective in polymer-based compounds where durability and flexibility are essential. The substance is supplied as a clear liquid suitable for direct incorporation into both aqueous and oil-phase systems. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet the requirements of personal care and industrial buyers respectively. Standard packaging includes drums and IBCs for various logistics needs. Bulk quantities are available for industrial procurement to ensure consistent supply chains.
